## Core Specializations

### 1. Full Stack Software Development
- **Frontend:** React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, HTML5, Vanilla CSS
- **Backend & APIs:** Node.js, Express.js, RESTful APIs, JWT Authentication, MVC architecture
- **Databases:** MongoDB, Mongoose, NoSQL
- **Key Projects:**
  - **AI Smart City Companion Platform:** Full stack civic discovery and issue tracking web app built with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Leaflet routing.
  - **Kinetic Editorial Portfolio:** High-performance responsive web application built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.

### 2. Motion Pictures & Cinematic Video Editing
- **Focus:** Narrative cinematic cuts, speed ramping, color grading, pacing, sound design, and viral short-form content.
- **Formats:** 4K Anamorphic cinematic edits and vertical 9:16 reels/shorts optimized for high retention on Instagram and YouTube.
- **Tools & Workflows:** Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut Pro, After Effects, Beat Sync, Color Science.

### 3. Art Direction & Visual Design
- **Focus:** Typography, brutalist and minimalist poster design, social media creative systems, brand identities, and photography.
- **Projects & Platforms:** Creator behind @chroma__canvas, producing educational carousels, aesthetic grids, and visual design assets.
- **Tools:** Canva Pro, Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Lightroom, Illustrator.

### 4. Digital Marketing & Content Strategy
- **Capabilities:** Organic audience growth, hook optimization, community engagement, brand positioning, and content architecture.
